core_tier_summary.derivation: Deterministic, precedence-ordered: (1) semantic_role Sugar -> sugar; (2) semantic_role Exploratory -> material (child-runtime is outside the Core contract, algebra.handle.domain); (3) kind moduleword -> material (Hosted Modules, SPECIFICATION.html section 9.3); (4) otherwise the tier of the entry home algebraic_family, where observation splits to material iff derived_from includes algebra.observation.digest or algebra.handle.domain, else identity. derived_from is NOT used as the primary signal because it lists every law a word obeys (e.g. arithmetic obeys NIL pass-through), not what the word is. See docs/dev/ajisai-minimal-core-identity.md.

tiers.identity: Value-space separation and the three propagation disciplines (NIL, Kleene K3 U, structured diagnostic). Part of Minimal Core.
tiers.flow: State-transformer monoid, modifiers, dictionary resolution. Part of Minimal Core.
tiers.material: Algorithms and hosted layers (exact arithmetic, vectors/tensors, hosted modules and effects, child runtime). Derived library / self-host targets; bound by identity laws but outside Minimal Core.
tiers.sugar: Sealed surface grammar (delimiters, symbol sugar, directives). Fixed frame, not a self-host target.

entries.notes: Boolean value; distinct from numeric 1/1.
Boolean value; distinct from numeric 0/1.
Primitive operational absence; distinct from FALSE, numeric zero, and logical UNKNOWN. Reasoned NIL values propagate through NIL-passthrough words.
Operational-absence predicate; consumes the inspected value and projects absence into the K3 truth domain. Reports TRUE for the logical UNKNOWN, which is an absence (LANG.VALUES.TRUTH).
Reads the direct reason of an operational NIL as a lowerCamelCase protocol-string Text; consumes the inspected value; NIL when there is no reason. For a userDeclared NIL it answers the declared text.
Consumes a Text and produces a NIL with reason userDeclared whose parameter is that Text; the Text is part of value identity and is what NIL-REASON answers. Non-text operand is an ERROR.
Strong Kleene conjunction over TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN. The U rows arise from a NIL read in truth position; they are pinned by native logic tests.
Strong Kleene negation.
Exact rational arithmetic; division by zero observes NIL rather than host exceptions.
Exact-real addition as a bihomographic arithmetic word; NIL operands pass through unchanged.
Exact-real subtraction as a bihomographic arithmetic word; NIL operands pass through unchanged.
Exact-real multiplication as a bihomographic arithmetic word; includes arbitrary-precision integer observations.
Exact-real division as a bihomographic arithmetic word; division by zero projects to NIL rather than a host exception.
FLOOR — exact-real integer projection toward negative infinity. Projecting failures create NIL observations.
ROUND — exact-real nearest-integer projection without float round trips. Projecting failures create NIL observations.
Comparisons over the exact field always decide and produce Boolean observations.
Budgeted exact-real equality projected into the K3 truth domain; NIL operands pass through unchanged.
Exact-real strict less-than projected into the K3 truth domain; it always decides.
Greater-than is the operand-dual of LT over the shared exact order primitive.
Irrational observations are canonical continued fractions, never sqrt(...) Debug-style wrappers or ~ rational approximations.

Exact power inside the exact field (power.rs): integer exponents by square-and-multiply in the base's tier, p/2 exponents over a non-negative rational base in the field through SQRT; every other exponent leaves the field and projects domainMiss. Projects divisionByZero, domainMiss and spaceExhausted as the contract declares.
The greatest common divisor of two integers, the reduction the machine already runs on every rational; non-integers project domainMiss.
entries.native_retention_reason: Euclid's algorithm is input-dependent repetition; the language repeats only over a Vector that already exists, so no definition can write it.

entries.notes: A rational's reduced numerator and denominator as a two-element Vector; irrationals project domainMiss.
entries.native_retention_reason: Reads the reduced representation the language keeps but exposes through no other Word; nothing in the vocabulary can write it.

entries.notes: K3-honest choice between two values: UNKNOWN chooses neither and answers the absence it read. Nothing is evaluated, so the choice is an ordinary lifted operation rather than a control construct.
Executes a code value by reflecting it into state-transformer composition.
Consumes a Text and raises an ERROR of category declaredFailure carrying that Text; evaluation halts and no Word catches it. Non-text operand is a nonText ERROR.

Answers a Core Word's registered contract from the generated registry as a Record, and a User Word's or a bare block's inferred contract through the one inference ajisai check --contract runs (word_contract.rs, infer_word_contract / infer_contract_for_block), in one shape (contract_record.rs). A block is never evaluated. A Symbol naming nothing projects notFound; an operand that is neither a Symbol nor a block is notASymbol. Absorbed PROBE after the vocabulary-100 review.
Functorial/applicative lift of a block over an indexed sequence.
Predicate restriction over an indexed sequence using a K3 truth-valued block.
entries.native_retention_reason: Fixes predicate truth/NIL policy, index-order visitation, isolated callbacks, and atomic ERROR restoration.

entries.notes: Catamorphism over an indexed sequence with an explicit accumulator and combiner state transformer.
FOLD's catamorphism with every intermediate accumulator retained: one lane out per lane in, the seed excluded.
entries.native_retention_reason: Re-folding each prefix is quadratic where the walk is linear, and the language has no loop or recursion to carry state any other way; also fixes index-order visitation, isolated callback stacks and effect order.

Cardinality observation over the indexed-sequence structure.
Prefix/suffix projection over the indexed-sequence structure.
The other half of TAKE's cut over the indexed-sequence structure: the remainder after a prefix (or suffix) is removed.
Free-monoid concatenation of ordered vector sequences.
Involutive order reversal on indexed sequences.
Deterministic construction of an inclusive integer indexed sequence.

Tensor constructor that fills a requested shape with a repeated value.
entries.native_retention_reason: Checks shape overflow and the materialization ceiling before allocation.

entries.notes: Shape observation over the reshape group: the axis lengths of a rectangular nesting, outermost first; a ragged nesting has none and projects domainMiss.
Reshape-group action: the leaves regrouped under a new shape whose product is their count; honors the materialization ceiling as FILL does.
Collapse every axis into one. Inexpressible as a user definition: the depth is unknown in advance and the language has no recursion.
Nesting-depth observation. Inexpressible as a user definition for the reason FLATTEN is.
Record laws exist, but conformance still needs representative record observations before marking Formalized here.
String algebra has law coverage; conformance still needs stable encoding/role cases.
Splits a text value into the finite codepoint sequence of one-character text values.
Folds a vector of text/codepoint fragments back into one text value.
Whitespace-normalization endomorphism over codepoint sequences; idempotent at fixed points.
The upper-case form of a String under Unicode's default, locale-independent case mapping (cast_text_ops.rs); no language-specific rule is applied, so the same text maps the same way wherever it runs.
entries.native_retention_reason: The mapping table is Unicode's own, which no definition over CHARS and JOIN could carry; the top of the work order's waiting list, admitted when NEQ and PROBE freed two slots.

entries.notes: Splits a codepoint sequence by a separator sequence into ordered text parts.
First occurrence of a codepoint sequence inside another, as a character position; absent projects notFound.
entries.native_retention_reason: One pass with a sliding window; spelled over CHARS the window is rebuilt and compared at every position.

entries.notes: Every non-overlapping occurrence of a codepoint sequence substituted, left to right; an empty pattern matches nothing.
entries.native_retention_reason: One pass with a sliding window and a single rebuilt text; spelled over CHARS and JOIN it is a window at every position and a rebuild per match.

entries.notes: Parses text/codepoint sequences into exact numbers; malformed numeric text projects to NIL.
Renders a value into canonical text/codepoint-sequence form under the text role.
The one rounding boundary: a scalar rendered as decimal text at a stated digit count, a tie away from zero as ROUND and QUANTIZE round, exact at every tier: the field decides every digit.
entries.native_retention_reason: Written out it is QUANTIZE followed by digit surgery on STR's text, which scatters the language's one rounding rule over two Words and a user definition; kept native so the boundary is one place.

entries.notes: An iterative JSON reader (json_decode.rs) that lands objects on Records, arrays on Vectors and numbers on exact rationals; malformed text projects invalidEncoding, nesting past the machine's bound projects spaceExhausted.
entries.native_retention_reason: Nesting is input-dependent repetition; the language repeats only over a Vector that already exists, so no definition can write this Word at all.

entries.notes: The inverse writer (json_encode.rs): finite decimals as JSON numbers, every other rational as its lexeme in a string so nothing is rounded, and domainMiss for a value with no JSON image; decoding what it writes gives back the value.
entries.native_retention_reason: The recursive walk over nested Records and Vectors is the same input-dependent repetition the decoder needs; a definition cannot write it.

entries.notes: User dictionaries and module imports are deterministic name-resolution observations.

Reading a Word's reference or source is a host query over the active dictionary: it resolves by the same Core -> user order a program does, answers with a structured observation (documentation, definition, or Unknown), and changes no session state. It was the Word LOOKUP until the vocabulary stopped claiming that reference prose is a value a program can hold.
PRINT is the outbound rendering boundary: it renders the consumed value and appends a host effect after capability gating.
entries.implementation_schema: hosted_effect_schema(capability.check -> request construction -> Eff append -> structured observation)

entries.notes: BIND extends the frame's local finite partial map with a name, and the map dies with the frame. The same algebra as the dictionary, scoped to LANG.SOURCE.FRAME rather than the session, which is what keeps it from being a second name space.
DEF extends the User dictionary finite partial map with a content-addressed binding while preserving the sealed Core tier.
DEL removes user dictionary bindings; for fresh definitions, DEF followed by DEL restores name resolution to Unknown, while module dictionaries remain intact.

Exposes the content identity the dictionary already keeps (word_identity.rs) for a Symbol naming a Word, and the denotation digest of any other value through the observation digest's own value encoder (observation_digest.rs, value_digest), so equal values digest alike whatever built them.
Child-runtime semantics are modeled but not yet part of the Core portability contract.
entries.reason: Child-runtime semantics are modeled but not yet part of the Core portability contract.

entries.notes: Sorts indexed sequences by the exact order observation, which decides every pair.
entries.native_retention_reason: Fixes deterministic ordering and restores the original operand atomically on comparison ERROR.

entries.notes: The stable ascending permutation of an indexed sequence under the exact order observation; SORT is this permutation applied.
entries.native_retention_reason: Ordering with the positions kept. The Kernel-only route ranks each position by counting the positions before it, which is O(n^2) interpreted steps against this Word’s O(n log n) comparisons.

entries.notes: First-occurrence deduplication over value equality, so it applies to domains that carry no order.
entries.native_retention_reason: Deduplication in one pass; the Kernel-only route rescans the prefix at every position, which is O(n^2).

entries.notes: A Record from each distinct element to its count, keys in UNIQUE order, produced by the same pass so the two cannot disagree; VALUES is the aligned count Vector the earlier form answered.
entries.native_retention_reason: Counting in the same pass that finds the distinct values; written out it is a second O(n^2) scan that can drift from UNIQUE’s order.

entries.notes: Positional bundling of equal-length sequences; transposition and index-walking are the same operation read differently.
entries.native_retention_reason: One traversal instead of a nested index gather; the Kernel-only route builds an index vector per position and pays a GET for each.

entries.notes: Single-position replacement on an indexed sequence; a negative index counts from the end.
entries.native_retention_reason: Replaces one element without rebuilding the sequence through a per-element conditional or a three-phrase slice-and-rejoin.

entries.notes: A Record from each key to the Vector of its values, keys in UNIQUE order, every value kept exactly once; a group is read back by its key with AT.
entries.native_retention_reason: One traversal instead of a scan of the key vector per distinct key, which is O(n*k) with the index plumbing written by hand.

entries.notes: Projects the first equal element position from an indexed sequence, or NIL if absent.
Membership over value equality: whether one value occurs in the vector, derivable as INDEX-OF NIL? NOT.
First index of each key in an ascending vector by halving, after one pass that checks the order; an absent key projects notFound.
entries.native_retention_reason: Halving a range until it is empty is a loop whose length depends on the data, which a language with no unbounded loop cannot write; m keys cost O(n + m log n) against INDEX-OF's O(m·n).

entries.notes: Builds a Record from a key Vector and a value Vector paired by position; keys keep their order; a repeated key or unequal lengths is an ERROR. The domain's only constructor.
The key Vector of a Record in its own order, aligned with VALUES.
The value Vector of a Record aligned with KEYS; RECORD over KEYS and VALUES rebuilds the Record.
The value under a key in constant expected time; an absent key projects notFound.
A copy with one key set: in place when present, appended when not; a NIL value is stored, a NIL key or Record is an ERROR.
A copy with one key removed; an absent key projects notFound, as GET/TAKE/PUT project a position outside the Vector.
Whether a key is present, without reading the value, so a stored NIL and an absent key are told apart.
Right-biased union: left order kept, right values win on shared keys, right-only keys appended.
Selects the smaller operand using the exact order, which always decides.
Selects the larger operand using the exact order, which always decides.
Line-comment source directive: lexical-only, ignored before runtime token evaluation; not a runtime word.
Vector opening delimiter; parser-level structure for vector literal construction, not a runtime word.
Vector closing delimiter; parser-level structure for vector literal construction, not a runtime word.
String-literal delimiter, serving as both open and close. The lexer resolves it, so it is not runtime vocabulary; `alias.quote` records the separate editor affordance of the same character.

Surface sugar for EQ; desugaring is observation-transparent.
